Live repro from this session (tsk-myq): called fgos plan tsk-myq --verdict pass-through, then fgos list --id tsk-myq --json immediately after -- status read doing, not todo as the skill doc asserts. Confirmed via source (plan.mjs's stub) this is not a fluke.

Scope: update fgos-coding-validating/SKILL.md's Handoff section (and its Next framing in fgos-coding-implement/SKILL.md if it makes the same assumption -- check) to state the current tsk-40m D5 behavior (claim persists through executing, no release/reclaim window) instead of the retired one, citing D5. Low risk, docs-only, no code change implied.
